# Landometer Design System 0.9.5
Current version: 0.9.5. Color Set: color-srgb-08. Package: v0.9.5-owner.1 (owner-approved, unsigned).
- [Human and machine reference](https://montri-th.github.io/Landometer/v0.9.5/)
- [Canonical source](https://github.com/montri-th/Landometer/tree/main/plugins/landometer-design-system)
- [Release](https://github.com/montri-th/Landometer/releases/tag/v0.9.5)
Use exact bundled assets. Retain brand voice/visual from 0.9.1. Do not use historical color-srgb-05 or inherited color-srgb-07 for a new unpinned artifact. Explicitly pinned older projects retain their release until migration. Package verification is not universal output conformance. Team account activation is separate from local installation.
